support: FYI ticket #12345 from ACME reports sudden 5xx surge + billing spike after we shipped new client packages this morning. They say it started right after a token rotation.
support: Logs show repeated retries (4x) for requests that return 401/500, lots of duplicate calls. Billing doubled in an hour.
incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-421 (priority: high) and linked ticket #12345.

tanvi: I can repro locally against prod-mock. behaviour looks like retry loop after auth transient. quick repro:
```
export RW_KEY=rotated_token
python examples/stream_test.py --concurrency 8 --requests 500
```
Results: ~30% 5xx, many retries logged.

kevin: Which client version? we shipped multiple language updates today.

support: They reported python-client==1.3.0 and ts-client@1.3.0. Go client untouched.

jordan: I pulled the generated python client diff — CI regen bumped default retry config. previously default was exponential+jitter with max 6, now codegen puts fixed backoff 500ms and max 4. looks like an OpenAPI extension got in: `x-default-retry: fixed_500ms` in spec.

kevin: ah — fixed, low backoff + no jitter + token rotation means a thundering herd on token refresh window. that would explain spike and duplicate auth attempts.

tanvi: confirmed: swapping back to the older retry policy locally (exponential with jitter) removes the repeat failures. patch idea: override client config until we regen spec properly.

jordan: snippet to force old behaviour:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(retries={"strategy":"exponential","base_ms":200,"max_attempts":6,"jitter":true})
```

dylan: Is this a codegen bug or spec problem? Who added `x-default-retry`?

jordan: git log on the spec repo shows an automated rule that started emitting the extension during an unrelated change to the /embeddings path. looks like a generator upgrade pulled in a default mapping for retries. PR: https://git.internal/specs/changes/7482 (auto-generated).

support: Customer-facing mitigation sent: instruct to pin client to 1.2.9 or set explicit retries as above. They asked for timeline to fix CI + backport.

kevin: action items: 1) devex - add hotfix to python/ts SDKs to respect an env override for retry policy (RW_RETRY_POLICY) 2) eng-runtime - evaluate if we can short-circuit duplicate auth attempts at gateway 3) specs - revert x-default-retry until a deliberate rollout.

tanvi: I can push hotfix PR for python and ts today, target 1.3.1 patch. will include test that simulates token rotation window.

jordan: Also adding changelog note: explain spec extension and rationale. Big ask: add CI guard that prevents surprising x-extensions from being introduced without a manual review.

kevin: good. postmortem draft owner? tanvi?

tanvi: I'll own the postmortem and the hotfix. will post updates here and ping on incident channel when patch is released. :thumbsup:

support: customer ok with pin + temp env override. they want status updates every 2 hours.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-421 updated: state=investigating, severity=high.
